description: Show a Korean law's effective date in force and whether an amendment has been promulgated but is not yet in force (시행예정). If so, also lists the articles it changes and its addenda (부칙: effective dates, transitional provisions). With an English law name it answers in English and says whether the official English translation matches the version in force.

law.description: Official law name in Korean or English. E.g. 근로기준법, Labor Standards Act

name: get_law_status
title: Law status and upcoming amendments (법령 시행·개정 상태)
